osds.name: Ito
osds.author: Ryoku Team
osds.summary: A thread on the screen edge
osds.description: Volume, microphone and brightness rise as one slim thread against the right edge, the glyph above and the number below; past full volume the thread turns vermilion, and a keyboard layout change shows as a small tag at the top.

osds.name: Island
osds.author: Alan Betty
osds.summary: A black pill that springs from the top edge
osds.description: Volume, microphone, brightness and keyboard changes spring out from the top edge as a black pill, the glyph in a well of liquid glass and the level as a white bar that greys out when muted; past full volume the overflow shows in your accent.
